difficulty_reason: Proves T_x(M) (x) A B = T_y(M (x) B): reduces via the fppf sheaf of lifts (footnote proves applicability) to x lifting to the smooth cover U using a faithful flat etale extension and the sheaf-condition exact rows; then reduces via the groupoid exact sequence from Artin's Axioms to T_u and T_{e o u}; finally handles the algebraic-space case by the Inf = Hom(x*Omega, M) identification, lfp differentials and the Hom base-change lemma.
